name: Grafana Cloud
short: Managed observability stack (metrics, logs, traces, profiles, dashboards) with adaptive telemetry and an AI assistant; perpetual free tier and Grafana OSS self-hosting.

plans.name: Free (Cloud)
plans.notes: 10,000 metric series, 50 GB logs, 50 GB traces, 14-day retention, 3 users; all Grafana Cloud services with limits; community support; no credit card.

plans.name: Pro
plans.notes: Platform fee plus usage beyond free tier; 13-month metrics retention, 30-day logs/traces/profiles/k6 retention; 8x5 email support; usage rates: metrics from $6.50/1k series, logs from $0.05/GB ingest + $0.40/GB write + $0.10/GB retain.

plans.name: Enterprise
plans.notes: Custom retention, premium support, deployment flexibility (public cloud, federal cloud, or BYOC), volume discounts and custom retention; for compliance/security requirements.
